🛠️ That one’s on us. Here’s what went wrong: our baseball history was missing every game where the home team won without batting in the bottom of the 9th — over 10,000 games. So the engine thought road teams down late came back way more than they really do. It had the Guardians at 25% — real history says more like 14%. What we fixed: the engine uses the real numbers now, home and away split, and late in games it leans on what actually happened in that exact spot. No more chasing 9th-inning miracles. That shit won’t happen again.
